tests.name: Account deletion erases the member's raw health batches through the gateway erase-raw and keeps the account unless they are verified gone
tests.ref: npx vitest run src/lib/erase-health-raw.test.ts src/lib/erase-user-storage.test.ts src/lib/erase-user-data.test.ts
tests.reason: The only way to exercise request-account-deletion is to irreversibly delete a real account in the production Supabase project that staging shares, and the health store is forced off on staging, so there is no runtime probe (plan Tests, A3: Vitest only). These suites call the real erase-raw client over a mocked fetch: residual 0 erases, 404 HEALTH_STORE_DISABLED counts as erased, residual > 0, any error status, a 404 without that code, a body without a residual count, a network error and a missing service token all keep the account; and they pin the edge function's order (erase_user_data → erase-raw gate with storage_incomplete → auth user delete) next to the existing table and Storage gates.
